notes.title: Early Access release LIVE
notes.notes:
IT IS HERE

After a few delays and failed expectancies in the games direction and expected past release dates, the game is now released into early access.

What to expect?
Right now you can play through the game two times experiencing a new arena each time. There is an unlockable workshop where you can upgrade your starter weapon and an unlockable game mode named the arena. Here you can compete with other gamers in reaching the top of the leaderboard!

What’s coming?
In the next content update for The Holy Chalice, I’m targeting quality of life content such as more options for resizable windows, graphic options, and UI so it’s easier to tell WHERE to go in the player hub. 

After this update I’ll be diving into content content content! More weapons, more crafting at the player hub, more enemies and lastly more levels.

Thank you ALL for joining along with me, and if you have any questions you can always come to our discord!

https://discord.gg/zEyHjtWC

notes.title: The Holy Chalice release date
notes.notes:
The Holy Chalice will be releasing on April 20th.


With the hurdles of developing a game solo and the struggles of fighting the motivation of working on the game, I have pushed through the remaining boundaries preventing a release of a game I envisioned.

Thank you all for following the game in its development stages, it has been a huge process for myself and I am proud of what I have created as of now.

After release, expect bi-weekly updates on the progress of the game and additional content being added.
